note: Reading rules per host: main content selector, furniture to remove, elements serving as headings, headings whose sections are not content, and whether forms hold the content (forms_hold_content: a portal wraps each page in a form), the media server that relative upload URLs in a page's Nuxt data refer to (media_base; NNPC's runtime config names it mediaURL). Hosts without rules are read from <main> or <body> with standard furniture removed. A subdomain with its own site has its own entry: it would otherwise take its parent's rules.
